meta.title: SpaceX 6/4 re-mark — 多情景重算
meta.conclusion: 跨 S1/S3,SpaceX 6/4 反推到 $1.57T–$1.61T(部分 re-mark);full $1.77T 需要杠杆 0.70x(不可能)。结论:6/4 是中途价,full IPO $1.77T 估计 6/12 首日交易后落地。
meta.disclaimer: Reconciliation model, not filed data. SpaceX $-to-valuation mapping is linear off the 3/31 NPORT anchor ($3.89B @ $1.25T). The next NPORT (period 6/30, filed ~late Aug) is the next hard confirmation. Not investment advice.

scenarios.name: Leverage 准确 + Total Assets = gross
scenarios.fixed: L = 1.1358(3/31 NPORT);18.7B 视为 gross(杠杆后)
scenarios.note: 数据自洽的默认情形:SpaceX 反推到 ~$1.57T,部分 re-mark。

scenarios.name: SpaceX = full $1.77T 确定
scenarios.note: 要让 full $1.77T 只产生 +6.6% 的 NAV,杠杆得是 0.70x(<1 = 净现金),对杠杆基金不可能 → 反证 6/4 不是 full mark。

scenarios.name: Total Assets = net(真实 AUM)
scenarios.fixed: L = 1.1358;18.7B 视为 net AUM(非杠杆后)
scenarios.note: 若 18.7B 是 net,SpaceX 反推到 ~$1.61T,仍是部分 re-mark。
